title: Tight Sampling Complexity with Stochastic Gradient Oracles in Fixed Dimensions
summary: We establish the stochastic-gradient query complexity of sampling smooth strongly log-concave distributions in every fixed dimension $d\geq1$. For $μ$-strongly convex, $L$-smooth potentials with unknown minimizers $x_f^\star$ in the ball $\mathbb{B}(0,μ^{-1/2})$, and unbiased gradient oracles with variance at most $σ^2$, the minimax worst-case expected query complexity is $Θ\left(\log(1+κ)+\frac{σ^2}{μ\varepsilon}\right)$, jointly optimal for the condition number $κ:=L/μ$, variance $σ^2\ge 0$, and TV accuracy $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/10$.
